text: In 2025, South Korea declared a state of national disaster in Gangneung due to a severe flash drought, marking the first national disaster declaration for a natural hazard in the country. The initiative involved a comprehensive response to stabilize municipal water supplies, which included demand-side restrictions, emergency supply augmentation, and water quality management. The Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters coordinated the Level 2 response, mobilizing resources nationwide to address the crisis.
